# Codebase Architecture Blueprint (JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1)

Architecture blueprint and master plan have been generated and are available in the `.jules/` directory.

## Target Runtime
- Next.js 16+ (App Router, Turbopack Engine)
- React 19.2+
- TypeScript 5.5+
- Tailwind CSS v4.x / Native Modern CSS (OKLCH Color Space)

## Revolution Plan
Refer to `.jules/revolution-plan.json` and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for the step-by-step master implementation plan of route transformations and semantic content expansion.
